stemMd: Every successful appeal in the archive cites new evidence. No appeal citing new evidence was filed after the deadline. Therefore, no successful appeal in the archive was filed after the deadline. Which argument has the same pattern?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No metal sculpture is fragile; this sculpture is not metal; therefore it is fragile.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every licensed pilot is trained; some trained people are musicians; therefore some pilots are musicians.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every approved seed lot was tested; no tested lot was stored outdoors; therefore no approved seed lot was stored outdoors.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every winning team practised; this team practised; therefore it won.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some registered boats are wooden; no wooden boat is new; therefore no registered boat is new.

explanationMd: The form is all members of one class belong to a second, and none of the second belong to a third, so none of the first belong to the third. The seed-lot argument preserves both universal premises and the negative conclusion.

distractorRationale.e: A claim about some registered boats is expanded to all.
distractorRationale.b: A particular overlap replaces the universal exclusion.
distractorRationale.a: This denies an antecedent rather than chaining two universal premises.
